patterns.reason: hard-coded anonymous TLS cipher suite; disabled by the default jdk.tls.disabledAlgorithms value in JDK 11 and never negotiated even when set explicitly

rule_description: In JDK 11 the java.security property jdk.tls.disabledAlgorithms has the default value 'SSLv3, TLSv1, TLSv1.1, DTLSv1.0, RC4, DES, MD5withRSA, DH keySize < 1024, EC keySize < 224, 3DES_EDE_CBC, anon, NULL, ECDH, include jdk.disabled.namedCurves'. The 'anon' entry disables every anonymous key-exchange cipher suite (DH_anon, ECDH_anon), and the JSSE guide states these algorithms will not be negotiated for TLS/DTLS connections even if they are enabled explicitly by an application. JADE hard-codes anonymous suites in two places, so an SSLServerSocket configured with them raises an SSLHandshakeException at runtime on JDK 11 instead of completing an unauthenticated handshake.
rule_name: Anonymous TLS cipher suites are disabled by default in JDK 11
verification_hint: No .java file in the workspace matches (?:TLS|SSL)_(?:DH|ECDH)_anon_ any more, or every remaining match is proven unreachable. A JICP-S handshake between two JADE containers on JDK 11 completes without SSLHandshakeException, and all four consumers still PASS.
